title: Count pads in an area with a spatial iterator
summary: Sets up a spatial iterator with pad, layer and area filters to count the pads in a rectangle given in millimetres, and shows that AddFilter_Area returns objects that overlap the rectangle, not only those inside it.
phrasings: query PCB objects in a region

commands.name: CountPadsInArea
commands.description: Count the pads in a rectangle with a spatial iterator
commands.params: X1=<mm>|Y1=<mm>|X2=<mm>|Y2=<mm> (corners, default -1000,-1000 to 2000,2000)|FromOrigin (optional flag: values are offsets from the board origin)
